title: 雨夜的一杯温暖
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous cinematic close-up inside a quiet cafe on a rainy night. A handmade cream ceramic coffee cup rests on a dark walnut table beside a rain-streaked window. Warm amber pendant light illuminates gentle steam rising from the cup. Beyond the glass, soft teal and amber street lights reflect on wet pavement. Push In slowly with a shallow depth of field, realistic film photography, restrained warm color grading. At 00:02.000, one large raindrop slides down the glass behind the cup. The cup stays still. No people, no dialogue, no letters, no subtitles, no logos.

overall_soundscape: Gentle continuous rain against the window, a distant soft city ambience, intimate and calm. No speech.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet sparse warm piano phrase, two soft notes with a natural decay, underneath the rain.
